name: Tomato Basil Pasta
ingredients: Pasta, tomatoes, basil, garlic, olive oil, parmesan
instructions: Boil pasta. Saute garlic and tomatoes in olive oil. Toss with pasta and fresh basil, top with parmesan.

name: Chicken Fried Rice
ingredients: Rice, chicken breast, eggs, soy sauce, peas, carrots, spring onion
instructions: Cook chicken and set aside. Scramble eggs. Stir-fry rice with vegetables, add chicken and eggs back in, season with soy sauce.

name: Avocado Toast
ingredients: Bread, avocado, lemon juice, salt, chili flakes
instructions: Toast bread. Mash avocado with lemon juice and salt. Spread on toast and top with chili flakes.

name: Beef Tacos
ingredients: Ground beef, taco shells, lettuce, cheese, salsa, onion
instructions: Cook ground beef with taco seasoning. Fill taco shells with beef, lettuce, cheese, onion, and salsa.
